articles.author: Maritime Staff
articles.title: Severe strike halts cargo handling at Port of Mumbai
articles.description: Port workers initiate strike over wage negotiations, delaying container vessels.
articles.content: A sudden labor strike has closed all major terminals in the Port of Mumbai, halting cargo.
